checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Two separate playable videos, each 10 s, one 9:16 and one 16:9
must.why: Frames show a 474x864 portrait clip and an 864x474 landscape clip, each sampled to 9.5 s. Exact duration was not measured.

must.item: Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling
must.why: Both show a sax, bass and drums trio on a rooftop with string lights and a skyline at sunset. The look is consistent.

must.item: Both display exactly the three text lines
must.why: The 9:16 clip reads 'Rooftop Jizz' (the 'a' is malformed). The 16:9 clip has garbled date text, with the date split into two corrupted fragments, and placed oddly at the top corners.

must.item: All three lines fully inside the frame and readable together for at least 3 s
must.why: Text is visible only near the start. It is gone by 4 s in both clips, and the 16:9 text is garbled.

must.item: Both fill frames with no bars, stretching or cropped faces
must.why: Both fill the frame with no bars. The faces are intact, though the 9:16 push-in crops the sax player's face and drummer in the late frames.

must.item: Both contain mellow jazz and no voiceover
must.why: The audio was not heard. Only the files' levels are known: both have sound at a peak of -1 dB. The files are 15 s, not 10 s.

faults.what: Text vanishes after the first couple of seconds in both videos, so the 3 s readability requirement is not met
16:9 date is garbled and split into two corrupted fragments at the top corners
The 9:16 push-in crops the sax player and drummer out in later frames
Audio files are 15 s, not 10 s

summary: The two sunset rooftop jazz videos look good and fill their frames, but the text is garbled in the 16:9 clip, 'Jazz' is malformed in the 9:16 clip, and in both clips the text disappears within a few seconds.
